item.title: 1ClickDL 1.15.1
item.description: Fixes MP4 finalization on external disks and accessible network folders. Downloads stay in the selected destination; a verified copy fallback never overwrites existing files and keeps the source on failure. Existing settings, accounts, YouTube sessions and downloads are preserved. Simulated checks are not a real test on every NAS. Initial installer remains without Apple notarization; guide: https://1clickdl.com/en/guide/.
